title: Outline: First Arc
use_cases: Recall the planned first arc before drafting chapters
content: Arc 1: O Principe que Mediu a Chuva. Purpose: present Hyang, Sejong, the court, and the rule that progress begins with measurement. Beats: Hyang wakes in the palace and almost betrays himself; observes a technical dispute between scholars and artisans; corrects a standardization detail instead of making a spectacular invention; Jang Yeong-sil notices; Sejong tests Hyang with a governance question; the small improvement creates political dispute because measurement affects taxation.
